scheme.note: 5,486 entries inferred from the page OCR of 699 body pages, against the ~5,600 Thayer's really has. Rule: line-initial Greek headword, kept only on the max-weight alphabetical chain and only if paragraph-initial or a Strong's lemma (see convert_thayer_entries). 3,964 candidates dropped as out of alphabetical order, 112 in order but with no other evidence. A real entry the rule missed is not lost: its text is inside the entry before it. Every unit links to the page(s) of the page book `thayer` it was cut from, which is the checkable citation. 335 entries open on a headword OCR misread (one letter off, or in Latin lookalikes) and read back to the one Strong's lemma it can be: lex.headword keeps the OCR, lex.headword_read the reading. 157 more open where a SECOND OCR (pipeline/ocr_thayer2.py, the original JP2 scans) prints a Strong's headword the first OCR lost; only the boundary is taken from it, never a word of the text. The appendix pages after the last entry are not part of any entry. 5,092 entries linked to strongs-greek by headword (accents ignored); 14 matched more than one Strong's lemma and are left unlinked with the candidates under lex.strongs_candidates.
